text: SUPERVISOR — add to your queue: RAMPREAL-0606. User verbatim: "with the building pieces in general, the ramp, we need to make it an actual ramp lol. we currently have 2 things, ramp and stairs, but the ramp is also a staircase and not a ramp". The RAMP piece renders/reads as a staircase — make it an actual ramp: one smooth inclined plane (flat sloped surface, no steps), visually and physically distinct from STAIRS (which keeps its steps). Your collision slope heightfield is likely already a smooth incline — the VISUAL geometry is the lie; fix the mesh to match the collision (visual-collision coherence law). Keep your ramp side/back solid bands and walk-up guarantees green. Stairs stays as-is. Quick SELFSHOT of ramp vs stairs side by side. The user looking at a ramp and seeing a ramp is the PASS.
